commit.message:
docs: refresh README with verified content, dependencies, and diagram fixes

- Add a Dependencies section (SkiaSharp, BitMiracle.LibTiff.NET,
  Microsoft.Win32.Registry) sourced from the real .nuspec/.csproj manifests
- Correct the Enterprise Edition link to point at the .NET-specific
  products.aspose.com/words/net/ page instead of the family-level page
- Update the At a Glance diagram so the from-scratch document creation
  capability (Document()/DocumentBuilder() with no input file) is visible
  in the Core Capabilities label, matching the Key Capabilities prose
- Restore several previously-dropped worked examples and capability
  descriptions, each individually re-verified against the current source
- Refresh badges, structural-content coverage, and general prose accuracy

Every change was individually verified against the current source tree
and the real, live Enterprise Edition target page before being written.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

repo.description: Open-source .NET library for Word documents, built from the genuine Aspose.Words codebase. Create, read, and edit DOCX and convert to Markdown and plain text. No Microsoft Word required.
repo.name: Aspose.Words-FOSS-for-.NET
